programme.name: Nonprofits, Philanthropy and Volunteerism Interdisciplinary Minor

notes.text: This four-course minor enables students to learn about the nonprofit sector — its organizations, philanthropy and voluntary action. See complete description in the USC Price School of Public Policy section.
